config.sequence_selection: First _a clip in the next four distinct Zurich recording groups after previously used groups00-06. Names fixed before new event downloads/inference. Keep complete clips and all eligible queries, including poor or opposite results. Local official annotation package already present; no known project inference/method selection on these four groups. Not an official test set or external preregistration.
config.query_cohort: Full image timestamp grid with complete180ms raw-event support, first10complete queries warm-up excluded identically for all models
config.spike_input: Unchanged9x20ms signed bins,3internal steps,256letterbox; neurons reset each query; causal EMA across queries; descriptors actual3-step mean pre-smooth inputs
config.rvt_input: Native640x480 StackedHistogram10bins/polarity, cutoff255, fastmodeFalse; bottom pad to512x640. First query50ms, then each interval(previous_query,current_query], approximately50ms. Explicit recurrent states persist across the entire clip including warm-up, reset only at sequence start. Head/FPN runs every query, all states always update. This is a new stream-transfer protocol, not the older3x60ms reset reference or an official1Mpx benchmark reproduction.
config.rvt_seam: Three actual FPN feature maps entering yolox_head.stems; signed ANN features retained at native8/16/32 grids. One anchor-free candidate/site. Preserve3class argmax before retaining pedestrian/car, suppress two-wheeler sites; do not remap after deleting class.
config.roll: floor(height/3),floor(width/3) per scale; rectangular RVT grids audited separately
config.calibration: Thun only, dense threshold and each of67condition thresholds at <=1FP/query with float32 nextafter; actual final-threshold NMS guard required before any held-out output is evaluated. Spike dense thresholds must reproduce previous frozen values. New RVT stream requires its own Thun calibration. No held-out threshold selection.
primary_contrasts: EMA absolute minus EMA current preservation at20% under common dense threshold, per model and recording
EMA lag3 minus EMA current preservation with paired within-model MAE ordering
Absolute residual versus current and historical activity controls; all22rankings retained
config.endpoints: Own-dense matched GT identity/query preservation, full GT TP/recall, FPPI, small-object subset, distinct GT/dense tracks, trajectory-equal preservation and sampled loss runs; failures/censoring retained. No absolute200ms deadline.
config.guardrails: A preservation increase with more evaluation FP is a trade-off, not equal-FP superiority. Joint descriptive improvement requires kept>=reference, fullGT TP>=reference, FP<=reference and longest sampled loss run<=reference, with at least one strict improvement; no safety or practical-significance claim. Calibration matching is not test FP matching.
config.analysis: Each new recording reported separately; sequencewise directions/counts and median/range for four groups. No frame-independent p-values, universal claim or formal H1/H2/H3 verdict. Counterexamples refute universal versions. Same-network two checkpoints are not two independent architectures. Cross-architecture results are within-model allocation audits, not ANN-vs-SNN detector superiority.
config.preflight: Before new-group inference: Spike Thun raw outputs and all22scores reproduce protected prior caches; all-open branch replays exact. RVT full-open head replay and explicit-state continuation after intervening unrelated queries exact. Failing health/equivalence is reported, not hidden by deleting difficult groups or switching architectures.
config.secondary: No new risk/importance module or numerator-denominator hybrids selected from confirmation results. Any later tuning uses development data and requires a new untouched confirmation cohort.
limits: Four public DSEC training recording groups, same city/data provider; no geographic or official-test independence guarantee
Model pretraining and input/state protocols differ; same position ratio is not same compute
All complete detector work executes; candidate admission only
Model seeds and hardware energy not newly replicated
Weak dense coverage remains visible and limits conclusions
